title: EC 1.2.7 · Similarity-aware: ROC and PR curves
caption: Test-set ROC (top) and precision–recall (bottom) curves for seven classifiers on conjoint-triad (left) and k-separated bigram PSSM (right) features, EC 1.2.7 similarity-aware split, n = 23 with 26% positive. The thin horizontal line in the PR panels is the positive prevalence. Highest AUROC among the 14 curves: Conjoint triad with Random forest (1.000).
